capabilities: Sign in to an AudioPen account with an emailed one-time code
Sync AudioPen voice notes into the vault as Markdown files
Group synced notes into folders matching AudioPen folders
Write titles, dates, folders and tags as properties with the transcript folded underneath
Preserve local edits, moves and deletions across syncs
extras: Payment and account are required; the plugin contacts AudioPen's servers to sign in and download notes, and support is handled at audiopen.ai/support rather than in the README.
problem: AudioPen voice notes live in the AudioPen service, and there is no built-in way to pull them into an Obsidian vault as Markdown.
summary: Official AudioPen integration that syncs AudioPen voice notes into a vault as Markdown files grouped by AudioPen folders.
